# Anselmo Luiz Éden Battisti

> Professor at IMPA Tech and Ph.D. in Computer Science (UFF). Research on SFC placement across the edge–cloud continuum, virtual network functions, 5G and the Internet of Media Things. Co-founder of Webgenium (2007). This is his personal and academic website: publications, patents, projects, talks and every course taught since 2012.

- Name: Anselmo Luiz Éden Battisti
- Position: Professor, IMPA Tech
- Degree: Ph.D. in Computer Science, UFF
- Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
- Work address: IMPA Tech, Av. Prof. Pereira Reis, 76 - Santo Cristo, Rio de Janeiro - RJ, 20220-800, Brazil
- Email: anselmo@battisti.com.br
- Curriculum Lattes: https://lattes.cnpq.br/6937214674204474
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=vqylNDgAAAAJ&hl=pt-BR
- GitHub: https://github.com/anselmobattisti
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@AnselmoBattisti
- Google Patents: https://patents.google.com/?inventor=anselmo+battisti
- PhD thesis (PDF): https://github.com/anselmobattisti/publications/blob/main/docs/2025/Tese/tese.pdf

Every page of the site has a Markdown version with the content only: replace the trailing slash of the address with `.md`
(https://battisti.com.br/publication/ → https://battisti.com.br/publication.md; the home page is https://battisti.com.br/index.md).

## Research

- [Research](https://battisti.com.br/research/): overview of the research on placing, migrating and scaling virtualized network functions between the edge and the cloud.
